applicable_spec_version.note: Compatibility checks observed non-blank coded values only, not schema completeness, provenance, currency or truth on the ground. CKAN date and specification citation do not establish an applicable version.

rank_cross_check_2024.note: Report only, never correct. Read r_method digits independently in width/slope/step order (p22). Survey uses full table 3.3 intervals; trace uses only red-underlined readings (p20-21; figure 3.3 p22). Only observed width code 1 -> C is supported for trace; all other trace width codes and S/A/Z/X width readings are not_checkable because only width C is red-underlined on p21. Slope/step A/B/C use upper thresholds including zero; their Z bounds remain supported. Slope/step S (0 percent / 0cm) is black, not red-underlined on p21, so S and X are not_checkable for trace. Survey S stays supported. Missing/blank/other method digits use the union of supported readings only: width codes 2/3/4/99 retain only their survey reading; slope/step code 1 retains S from survey plus A/B/C from trace. Accepted membership is method_unknown, never plain consistent. Link precedence: not_checkable, inconsistent, method_unknown, consistent. Source link_id lists retain input order, capped at 100 per state/component with truncation and unavailable-ID counts. No source values, applicable-version UNKNOWN, verification or routability are changed.

literal_cooccurrences.note: Literal co-occurrence counts only; missing or duplicate endpoint identifiers have unknown floor. No floor equivalence or connectivity is inferred.
